newsitem.title: USA: GE Capital expands credit cards in Canada.
newsitem.headline: GE Capital expands credit cards in Canada.

text.p: GE Capital, a unit of General Electric Co, said on Tuesday that it has launched its first Canadian GE Capital/MasterCard corporate card program.

The program broadens GE Capital's servicing platform for business to business payment products to its multinational client base, further leveraging its existing U.S. and Canadian credit card operations, the company said.
Canada becomes the fourth country where GE Capital issues corporate cards by wholly owned affiliates, after the United States, the United Kingdom, and the Republic of Ireland, GE Capital said.
GE Capital's credit card presence in Canada has continuously expanded since its introduction in 1987, where it currently services over one million private label credit cards, the company said.
